params.body:
Sixth measurement on the Portal side, and the one four cards read. Reads the verdicts abovebeyond-ai/elixir#176 writes for `pages`.

- Pages and SEO: Basic tags (`tags`), Pages (`broken`), Missing (`missing`), Also missing (`extras`), Thin (`thin`), robots.txt (`robots`) each take Elixir's word; one Judged line covers those facets.
- Links: the rows keep Elixir's internal/external distinction as their weight; a Judged line carries the `links` verdict.
- Speed: the response-time line takes the `speed` verdict; the 1200 ms next to it is the fallback and goes with the follow-up. The server CPU lines belong to the `server` measurement and are untouched.
- Weakest pages lists rows, no rule of its own.

Behaviour on current rows unchanged. Two tests in a new `PagesCardTest`. Suite green except the worktree-only `BuildStampTest`; PHPStan and Pint clean. Branched from `origin/main` at 19ea34c, checked fresh before proposing.
params.title: The four cards on the pages measurement read Elixir's verdict per facet
